codeReview.summary: The context-menu.tsx component is a faithful 1:1 adaptation of the existing dropdown-menu.tsx component, correctly swapping all DropdownMenu references to ContextMenu and using @radix-ui/react-context-menu primitives. All required exports (ContextMenu, ContextMenuTrigger, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuSeparator) plus additional sub-components are present. The CSS classes, data-slot naming, props destructuring, and Radix wrapping patterns are identical to the reference. The only intentional difference is ContextMenuContent omitting sideOffset (correct for context menus which appear at cursor position) and using the correct --radix-context-menu-content-available-height CSS variable. Package @radix-ui/react-context-menu@^2.2.16 is properly installed. TypeScript compilation and all tests pass.

issues.description: Export order differs slightly from dropdown-menu.tsx: ContextMenuTrigger is listed before ContextMenuPortal, while in dropdown-menu.tsx DropdownMenuPortal comes before DropdownMenuTrigger. This is purely cosmetic and has no functional impact, but breaks the exact mirroring pattern.
